nodes.label: AshaSathi Logo Design
nodes.description: Core brand logo: bold green (#3DAA5C approx) text 'ASHA' on top row and 'SATHI' on bottom row. A house/home icon with a triangular roof, rectangular body, and a four-pane window is integrated vertically between the two 'A' letters of 'ASHA', rising above the text. White background. Clean, friendly, housing-themed branding for a healthcare/social support app.

nodes.label: Android 12 Splash (Night, MDPI)
nodes.description: AshaSathi logo on white background. Smaller canvas/resolution (MDPI ~160dpi). Night mode variant — logo icon is visually identical to light mode (green on white); Android system applies dark background separately. Compact proportions due to lower density.

nodes.label: Android 12 Splash (Night, XHDPI)
nodes.description: AshaSathi logo on white/light background, XHDPI resolution (~320dpi). Night mode variant. Logo design identical: green bold 'ASHA SATHI' wordmark with integrated house icon. Slightly larger pixel dimensions than MDPI variant.

nodes.label: Android 12 Splash (Night, XXHDPI)
nodes.description: AshaSathi logo on white background, XXHDPI density (~480dpi). Night mode variant. Same green-on-white logo composition. Larger canvas allows more logo detail to render crisply on high-density screens.

nodes.label: Android 12 Splash (Night, XXXHDPI)
nodes.description: AshaSathi logo, highest night-mode density (XXXHDPI, ~640dpi). White background. Identical green wordmark + house icon composition. Sharpest rendering among night variants due to highest pixel density.

nodes.label: Android 12 Splash (Light, XHDPI)
nodes.description: Light-mode Android 12 splash asset at XHDPI density. AshaSathi logo: green 'ASHA SATHI' wordmark with house icon on white background. Used as the adaptive icon source for Android 12 splash screens in standard (light) system theme.

nodes.label: Legacy Splash Screen (XHDPI)
nodes.description: Legacy (pre-Android 12) splash screen image at XHDPI density. Shows AshaSathi green-on-white logo: 'ASHA' over 'SATHI' with house icon. Visually identical design to android12splash variants but used for older Android splash screen mechanism.

nodes.label: Android 12 Splash (Light, XXHDPI)
nodes.description: Light-mode Android 12 splash at XXHDPI density (~480dpi). AshaSathi logo: medium-green bold wordmark and house icon on white background. High-resolution rendering for devices like Pixel mid-range and Samsung Galaxy S series.

nodes.label: Legacy Splash Screen (XXHDPI)
nodes.description: Legacy splash screen at XXHDPI density. Same AshaSathi green wordmark + house icon design on white background. Used for older Android splash screen method on high-density devices.

nodes.label: Android 12 Splash (Light, XXXHDPI)
nodes.description: Light-mode Android 12 splash at highest density (XXXHDPI, ~640dpi). AshaSathi logo at maximum sharpness: green bold 'ASHA SATHI' wordmark with integrated house icon, white background. Targets flagship devices with ultra-high-density displays.

nodes.label: Splash Background (API 21+, Dark)
nodes.description: Solid near-black/dark background image used as the window background for the splash screen on Android API 21 (Lollipop) and above, predating Android 12 splash API. Provides a dark backdrop; the logo is overlaid separately. No visible design elements — purely a flat dark color fill.

nodes.label: Night Mode Android 12 Splash Group
nodes.description: Group of 4 night-mode Android 12 splash assets (mdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi). All share the same AshaSathi green-on-white logo design; density variants exist to serve different screen DPI buckets. The night qualifier allows Android to select these in dark system theme, though the icon itself remains green-on-white.

nodes.label: Light Mode Android 12 Splash Group
nodes.description: Group of 3 light-mode Android 12 splash assets (xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi). Standard theme splash icons. All use same AshaSathi wordmark + house icon on white background.

nodes.label: Legacy Splash Screen Group
nodes.description: Group of 2 legacy splash.png assets (xhdpi, xxhdpi) for pre-Android 12 splash mechanism. Identical visual design to android12splash counterparts but used with older WindowBackground approach.

hyperedges.label: All AshaSathi Splash Screen Assets
hyperedges.description: All 10 image assets together form the complete Android splash screen asset system for AshaSathi, covering night/light modes, legacy/Android12 APIs, and multiple screen density buckets.
